description: ASR RecoveryPlan provider-specific details are polymorphic on instanceType (A2A, Azure, HyperVReplicaAzure, InMageRcm, ...); the converted model keeps only the `instanceType` discriminator, so S.Struct strips every subtype field on encode and decode. Retype them as untyped documents.
